assumptions.basis: Internal conservative launch price anchored to narrow measurable workflow, not a sourced market average.
assumptions.validation: Ask 25 qualified partners and track paid conversion.
assumptions.kill_threshold: No paid pilot after 100 qualified touches.

assumptions.assumption: Recurring fee is $900 per location per month plus usage.
assumptions.basis: Internal model, benchmarked against published outcome and usage pricing from Intercom, Zendesk, Twilio, Vapi, and Retell.
assumptions.validation: Test willingness to pay after pilot ROI report.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Median accepted recurring price below $500 with support burden above 45 minutes/month.

assumptions.assumption: Base case: 1 paid pilot per 100 qualified touches.
assumptions.basis: Conservative internal planning assumption; not presented as an industry benchmark.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Zero qualified positive replies after 100 touches.

assumptions.assumption: Base case: 50% of successful pilots convert to recurring.
assumptions.validation: Measure pilot-to-recurring conversion over first 5 pilots.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Fewer than 2 of first 5 pilots convert.

assumptions.assumption: A bounded text-first workflow can reach 80%+ automation with human fallback.
assumptions.basis: Capability evidence from tool-using models and communications APIs; buyer-specific reliability remains unproven.
assumptions.validation: Run synthetic and shadow-mode tests before production.
assumptions.kill_threshold: More than 15% of interactions require founder intervention after templating.

assumptions.assumption: Steady-state owner time can fall below 45 minutes per customer per month.
assumptions.basis: Requires standardized onboarding, automatic monitoring, and partner-led support.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Owner time remains above 120 minutes/customer/month after 60 days.

assumptions.basis: Internal cost model using published API pricing and contractor assumptions.
assumptions.validation: Reconcile actual usage, support, and contractor cost monthly.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Contribution margin below 55% for two consecutive months.

assumptions.assumption: Arabic-English capability improves partner interest in GCC/MENA.
assumptions.basis: Regional model investment and expanded speech tooling; actual dialect reliability must be tested.
assumptions.validation: Run a bilingual synthetic benchmark and 20 GCC partner interviews.
assumptions.kill_threshold: Arabic workflow error rate exceeds 10% on business-critical slots or does not improve conversion.
